notes.text: Rent is due on the 1st of each month, paid to the landlord Senhor Costa by bank transfer.
The flat is 3E, third floor, no lift, in Graça.
Deposit was two months of rent, 1900 euros.
Utilities: EDP for electricity, NOS for internet, water through the condominium.
Day rate is 300 euros. Take a 50% deposit before work starts.
Current clients: Casa Azul, Studio Maré, Café Beira, Quinta do Vale, Doce Lisboa, Fábrica Norte, Livraria Sol.
Invoices are net 30. Chase anything past 45 days.
Classes are Tuesday and Thursday evenings at Língua Viva, level A2.
Tutor Rita on Saturday mornings for conversation.
Goal is B1 by next summer.
Likes warm, tactile, slightly imperfect work: grain, hand lettering, tiles.
Save links to posters, type specimens and exhibitions here.
The AIMA residence permit expires on 15 March 2027, so start renewing in December.
The NIF is needed for nearly everything. Keep a scan in the cloud.
Accountant is Dra. Luísa Pinto. Quarterly IVA is due on 15 February, May, August and November.
Canadian passport expires in 2027.
Usual shops are Pingo Doce on Avenida de Roma and Lidl for basics.
Saturday morning at the Feira de Alvalade for vegetables.
Mostly vegetarian on weekdays. Oat milk, not cow's milk.
Prefers trains to driving, no car.
Budget is around 300 euros for a weekend away.
Wants to see Porto, the Azores and the Alentejo this year.
Mum lives in Toronto, five hours behind Lisbon.
Anything with no thread yet lands here.
Friend Inês lives in Porto, birthday 14 March.

memories.text: They moved from Toronto to Lisbon.
They pay rent on the 1st to their landlord Senhor Costa.
They are learning Portuguese, at level A2.
They eat mostly vegetarian on weekdays.
They do not own a car.
They prefer to travel by train.
Their friend Inês lives in Porto.
Their clients include Casa Azul and Studio Maré.
They live in the Graça neighbourhood.
